_note: Minervini VCP breakout = spec Part 1 (user document 2026-11-12), see trader/strategies/vcp_breakout.py. Every value below is the spec's unless its own _note says otherwise. Condition 8 (RS >= 70) = rs_rank filter gated at rs_rank_min_percentile (13-week return vs NIFTY500, universe percentile - the spec's 3-month proxy with NIFTY500 for the S&P 500); set null to treat condition 8 as optional, which the spec allows. All other overlay filters are excluded: they are not part of the spec. Disabled by default; run with --strategy vcp_breakout.

execution._note: intraday = the spec's orders simulated on daily OHLC: buy-stop entry filled on the trigger session at max(open, pivot); resting hard stop filled at min(open, stop) when the low reaches it. Close-conditioned rules fill at the next open (a market order placed after the close). same_bar_stop 'assume_hit': a session that reaches both entry and stop is booked as stopped out, because daily bars cannot show the order. 'next_open' = old EOD model (not spec).

sizing._note: Spec Part 3, applied to this strategy only (other strategies keep risk_config.json as-is). Risk Dollars = Account_Equity * 1%; Risk Per Share = Entry - SL; Size = floor(Risk Dollars / Risk Per Share); if Size * Entry > Account_Equity * 20%, cut to 20%. Account_Equity = current equity (cash + open positions at market) -> capital_mode 'equity'. The system's non-spec sizing extras are switched off here: no 3% minimum stop distance, no minimum notional, no cash buffer, no portfolio open-risk cap. Still applied (not rules, physical limits): available cash and the portfolio-wide max_positions in risk_config.json.

exit._note: target_r 2.0 = 1:2 R:R on trim_fraction 0.5, stop -> exact entry. trail_mode: the spec says 'trail the remainder using a 20-day EMA' without saying how - 'stop' = resting stop at max(entry, EMA20) updated each close (default), 'close' = exit next open after a close below EMA20.
